# How to Escape?
This section covers how to breach containment if you have been assigned the role of SCP-096.
[textlink="General Information about The Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
[textlink="Detailed Guide to Containing The Shy Guy (for Facility Personnel)" link="Scp096Containment"]
## The Primary Method
This method involves utilizing the [bold]"Face Rip"[/bold] ability, which is available to you right from the start.
[textlink="More Details on Abilities" link="Scp096Abilities"]
Each use of this ability inflicts damage to your face. Using the ability 5 times consecutively will transition you into the "Torn Face State." [bold]In this state, you will be able to:[/bold] - Open any airlocks and blast gates - Attack any personnel - Move freely throughout the facility
Keep in mind that while in this state, you cannot enter "Rage" mode if anyone sees your face!
[textlink="More on States" link="Scp096States"]
## Additional Method
You possess the ability "Emit a Wailing Cry," which deals massive damage to all structures within your line of sight. Use this ability to damage the walls of your containment cell.
Repeated use of this ability will damage the walls, eventually leading to their structural failure and your escape. The walls of your containment cell are extremely durable and highly resistant to the damage inflicted by your ability. However, standard walls—even the most reinforced ones within the facility—will crumble much faster.
Bear in mind that the ability functions only within the confines of the containment chamber. Furthermore, the facility staff is capable of repairing even damaged walls.
## An Alternative Method
A member of the staff might spot your face in one of the photographs. Should this occur, they will become your target for a brutal execution.
You will enter a state of "Rage" and burst out of your containment cell like a bullet. Once you have eliminated all your targets, you will find yourself deep within the facility—an opportunity to reveal your face to other Foundation personnel.
## How to Assess the Extent of Facial Damage?
As Shy Guy, you possess a greater awareness of your own face; consequently, you have access to more methods for assessing its condition.
- Hover your cursor over the image of your face located on the right side, within the status effects panel.
The appearance of your face reflects your current condition or the extent of your facial injuries. Hovering your mouse cursor over it allows you to hear commentary from your inner "voice" regarding the situation.
- Look at the icon located in the top-right corner of your character's display.
The more blood visible on the icon, the more severe your facial injuries are.
- Examine yourself.
Like other individuals, you can examine yourself to read a visual description of the wounds you have sustained.
## How to Resist Capture?
Once you have escaped your containment cell, the facility staff will begin efforts to recapture you. Your objective is to resist.
If you are able to attack them, do so. Remember that you are vulnerable to a crowd armed with non-lethal weaponry. The Foundation's containment technologies are sufficiently advanced to temporarily incapacitate you, leaving you drained of energy.
During this window, personnel may deploy containment gear that will further weaken you and suppress your abilities.
[bold]Monitor your stamina level closely, as it plays a critical role in your capture.[/bold]
